status: Read-only event/identity investigation; no fitting or identity promotion
rowConvention: Physical CSV line, header = 1; original row 56 means sourceLine 56
maorCandidates: All onset-compatible rows within the same six-character REC root; retain exact REC, same nine-character file and changed-file candidates separately. Whale equality is tested, never required or propagated. Unique compatible event fingerprint requires count, all 28 shared ICI columns and zero extra ICI29..40. Report duration conflicts separately. Retain every conflicting/colliding candidate and unmatched source ID.
cetiJoin: codanum joins codamd/codasp and both previous/current roles in coarticulation metadata, as documented. Retain duplicate IDs, inconsistent fields, missing timing and missing last-click positions. Spectral string length is a separately labeled click-label diagnostic, never a replacement for missing last-click position.
cetiCandidates: All original rows versus all distinct CETI timing variants: onset minus supplied tag-on matches TsTo within decimal rounding; end minus onset matches whole ICI duration, and available counts agree. No duration-only match. Explicit consecutive-coda pair corroboration requires unique matches, same exact original REC/local caller, ordered onsets, same supplied tag origin, first-click=1, and supplied gap agreement. Isolated compatible events remain distinguishable from sequence-supported links.
precision: Exact decimal integer arithmetic at 10^-40 seconds; acceptance allowance is the sum of half the final decimal units of measured inputs. Structural padding zero is exact. Supplied whole-second tag-on is the coordinate origin, not an invented +/-0.5 second uncertainty. Datetime fractions retain written nanosecond precision. Civil Gregorian arithmetic assigns no timezone. No binary-epoch subtraction, arbitrary epsilon, fitted per-event offset, or outcome-driven tolerance.
bridge: Maor codaNUM2018 numerically equal to CETI codanum is an inferred namespace bridge, not a documented crosswalk. Audit all overlapping IDs for duration, spectral click count, name, focal and timed-onset agreement; expose contradictions. Bridge-only candidates never count as direct timed CETI linkage.
identity: Documented CETI whale metadata applies to the CETI coda; linking it to an original event is inferred. Maor Name/Unit are constant per Tag and do not name all local callers. Focal=1 with non-placeholder Name and IDN is a separately labeled candidate only. UNID/ZZZ and IDN 0/9999 remain unknown; U is not unknown. No Individual column or Maor unknown-value dictionary was found. Never propagate a matched caller/Name/Unit to an entire REC or root.
coverage: Separate raw and validated annotations; core 723 (shared v0.1/v0.2) and coverage 1017. Distinct rows and role occurrences; current, target, previous focal, recent partner, lagged partner, feature history and all completed partner history. Fully identified means every distinct used current/target/history row has one unconflicted candidate producer, not official identity confirmation. Also report strict sequence-supported CETI-only coverage. Empty optional history is not a missing identity.
dependence: Flag repeated named producers, shared units and compatible date candidates across roots/folds. These are dependence risks, not established duplicate events or encounter boundaries. Keep conflicting/ambiguous dates as written; no timezone or date-format selection to force a join. Original folds and fitted artifacts remain unchanged.
rights: Maor README says MIT; LICENSE contains Apache 2.0. No separate data grant established. CETI pinned tree has no LICENSE or data-specific rights statement in README. Original archived CSV remains CC BY 4.0. External full files including notebook bytes stay gitignored; commit retrieval identities, audit code and derived mappings only.
reproduction: Deterministic full-file rerun compares exact serialized outputs without overwriting; independent Python stdlib Decimal/csv verification reconstructs mapping and coverage without importing the TypeScript matcher. Historical artifact preservation is checked against the base manifest. No study runner or downloaded code is executed.
